482 is also pretty easy, and many of the contents are similar to 438, but here you will learn something more about web technologies and have to build a website using html, css, js and php. Nqh is the go to faculty for learning but he is NOT easy going at all.
Go for 482 under NQH sir. You will learn very important concepts in detail, which will help in your career in the future. NQH IS NOT EASY GOING!! But I found the content very useful.
